item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello! Lovely to see you. It's Teachers' Day. Don't forget to thank your teacher! Here's your weather for Thursday, September 10. It's Thursday, almost the end of the week. In Shanghai today, expect it to be a little bit rainy. The high will be 30 degrees, and the low will be 21 degrees. It will feel hot and sticky out there. There is a 51 percent chance of rain. The sun goes down at 6:06 this evening, about 2 minutes earlier than yesterday. Can you feel the days getting shorter? Don't forget your umbrella today! As for tomorrow, expect it to be damp with light drizzle, with a high of 30 degrees. One more day of thinking about the moon. What stands out? That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
